errors.text_span: Веднага след това следва рязък спад до около 130 през 1995 г.
errors.evidence: The description states there was a sharp drop to about 130 in 1995. However, the chart shows that in 1995, the value for Bulgaria was at a local peak of approximately 200. The sharp drop to a value around 125-130 occurs in the following year, around 1996.
